notablePrerequisites: Chulane, Faeburrow Elder, Bloom Tender and Priest of Titania do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder and Bloom Tender by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{W}{W}{U}{U}.
Activate Pirest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Sky Hussar by paying {3}{W}{U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Sky Hussar to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control a black permanent, red permanent, an additional mana-producing creature, and/or at least one additional Elf, this combo nets infinite mana.
